name: GlideURI
title: GlideURI - Scoped
summary: The GlideURI API provides methods to handle URI parameters in a scoped application.
overview:
Note:
Do not use the GlideURI API in scripts that are executed during export or in background jobs.
For more information on using URIs:
  • Navigate by URL
  • Navigation stack

See also: GlideURI - Global .

members.name: get
members.summary: Returns the value of the specified parameter.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
name String The parameter name.
Returns
Type Description
String The value for the specified parameter. 
var gURI = new GlideURI();
gURI.set('sysparm_query', 'priority=2^active=true' );
var fileString = gURI.get('sysparm_query');
gs.info(fileString);

Output:

priority=2^active=true

members.name: getFileFromPath
members.summary: Returns the file name portion of the URI.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The file name portion of the URI. 
var gURI = new GlideURI();
 
var fileString = gURI.getFileFromPath();
gs.info(fileString);

members.name: set
members.summary: Sets the specified parameter to the specified value.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
name String The parameter name.
value String The value.
Returns
Type Description
None 
var gURI = new GlideURI();
gURI.set('sysparm_query', 'priority=2^active=true' );
var fileString = gURI.get('sysparm_query');
gs.info(fileString);

Output:

priority=2^active=true

members.name: toString
members.summary: Reconstructs the URI string and performs the proper URL encoding by converting non-valid characters to their URL code. For example, converting & to '%26'.
members.html:
Parameters set with the set() method are encoded with the URI as well.

Parameters
Name Type Description
path String The base portion of the system URL to which the URI is appended.
Returns
Type Description
String The URL. 
var gURI = new GlideURI();
fileString = gURI.toString('https://<your instance>.service-now.com/navpage.do');
